en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Al Husayn, from Abu Shuayb Al Mahamily, from Dorost Bin Abu Mansour, from Bureyd Bin Muawiya, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘It isn’t for Allah<sup>azwj</sup> upon His<sup>azwj</sup> creatures that they should be recognising, and it is for creatures upon Allah<sup>azwj</sup> that He<sup>azwj</sup> Introduces them, and for Allah<sup>azwj</sup> upon the creatures, that when He<sup>azwj</sup> has introduced them, so they should be accepting’.
